scope_statement: Owned production definitions in tracked src/bioetl, reached through shipped bioetl CLI, public composition/runtime factories, configured provider/storage/control-plane and optional health/telemetry paths. Includes OS files/temp descriptors, locks and compressed streams, native Delta reads/writes, HTTP clients/responses, processes/pipes, executors/threads/tasks and servers/exporters. In-memory DTOs, Arrow buffers and semaphores are not distinct external resources; injected resources retain caller ownership. Tests, scripts, IDE/MCP/Jules infrastructure, product data and user memory are outside the runtime resource denominator.
completeness_method: Review every tracked production Python file and supported CLI lazy-command/provider/factory/config wiring; enumerate direct acquisition primitives, delegated I/O and dynamic wiring; reconcile the 377 preserved heuristic candidates separately. Group repeated call sites by concrete ownership definition, retaining every file/line/expression and Git blob. async def _handle_connection(self, reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
    """Handle incoming HTTP connection.

        Args:
            reader: Async stream reader for the incoming TCP connection.
            writer: Async stream writer for sending the HTTP response.
        """
    try:
        await self._process_request(reader, writer)
    except TimeoutError:
        await self._send_response(writer, 408, 'Request Timeout')
    except self._request_error_allowlist as error:
        await self._handle_request_error(writer, error)
    except (ConnectionError, OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
        await self._handle_request_error(writer, error)
    except Exception as error:
        await self._handle_request_error(writer, error)
    finally:
        await self._close_writer(writer)
